lines.text: Typing 'Buy milk' into the #item input and clicking the #add button adds 'Buy milk' to the #todo list (list shows 1 item: 'Buy milk').
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Typing 'Walk dog' into the #item input and pressing the Enter key adds 'Walk dog' to the #todo list (list shows 1 item: 'Walk dog').
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Newly added items appear at the top of the #todo list: after adding 'Buy milk' then 'Walk dog' via #add, the list displays ['Walk dog', 'Buy milk'] (most recent first).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Clicking the .complete control on a #todo list item moves it to the #completed list: with only 'Buy milk' in #todo, clicking #todo li .complete results in #todo: 0 items and #completed: 1 item ['Buy milk'].
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Clicking the .remove control on a #todo list item deletes it: with ['Walk dog', 'Buy milk'] in #todo, clicking #todo li .remove leaves #todo with 1 item ['Buy milk'] (the top/first item is removed).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Clicking the #add button with an empty #item input adds no item (#todo and #completed both remain 0 items).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Deleting one of several identical todo items removes the wrong record from storage: with todos added in order aa, bb, cc, dd, aa, bb, cc, dd (stored as {"todo":["aa","bb","cc","dd","aa","bb","cc","dd"],"completed":[]}), deleting the fifth item (aa) removes it from the DOM, but the stored data becomes {"todo":["bb","cc","dd","aa","bb","cc","dd"],"completed":[]}; after a page refresh the list re-renders as bb, cc, dd, aa, bb, cc, dd instead of aa, bb, cc, dd, bb, cc, dd.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Clicking .complete on a duplicate item has the same first-instance mismatch: completing the fifth record (aa) removes the first 'aa' from the stored todo array (data.todo.splice(data.todo.indexOf(value), 1)), causing a disorder between the rendered list and stored data on refresh.
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: The todo list is stored locally in the browser (as a JSON structure with 'todo' and 'completed' arrays) and is not synced to a server: items entered on a Mac do not appear when the app is opened on an iPhone (the list is empty there).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: The todo list persists across page reloads within the same browser: after refresh, the page re-renders the todos from the stored todoList records.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: Todo items can be edited in place (e.g., to correct a typo) — an edit capability was contributed, along with tooltip tips for the task buttons.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: Long words in todo items wrap within the item instead of overflowing the layout (word-break CSS added).
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: On mobile, after completing a task and un-completing it back into the list, the completed-task marker/styling remains on the item (a visual bug).
lines.label: SEEN

lines.text: Pressing Numpad-Enter in the #item input adds the todo item the same as the main Enter key.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: Adding a todo consisting only of whitespace/empty content creates an empty task entry in the list (reported bug: 'Empty tasks can be created').
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: The page includes a viewport meta tag so the app renders properly scaled on mobile devices.
lines.label: GUESSED

lines.text: The app starts with an empty state: #todo shows 0 items and #completed shows 0 items.
lines.label: SEEN
